editorial:
Imagine waking up from a nightmare only to find out your actual life is way worse. You follow a woman and her old friend who are driven by a need for revenge against the people who hurt them when they were kids. The vibe is heavy and dark right from the start, making you feel the pain and anger these characters carry. It does not take long for the plot to shift from a simple revenge story into something much weirder and more scary, keeping you on edge as you try to figure out what the villains actually want.

The acting is solid and makes the scary parts feel real, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. If you like movies that push you to your limit and show things you cannot unsee, you will love this. Just be warned that it gets very intense. To get the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the sharpest picture, or you can rent it on Apple TV if you want a quick watch. If you are a big horror fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The ending reveals that a secret group is torturing people to see if they can glimpse the afterlife. They believe that extreme pain breaks a person's mind and lets them see a different world. The main character is tortured until she finally sees a vision of the other side. The leader of the group then kills her so he can hear her final words and learn the secrets of death before the movie cuts to black.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves extreme horror and dark mysteries.
